text:
maya: Heads-up: finalizing benchmark narrative for launch. Need hero copy, two clear charts, webinar outline, and inbound rules. Target: go/no-go by Tue EOD.

jon: high-level: hero should connect latency predictability to cost predictability. Not just fastest.

priya: charts idea: 1) scatter latency (median) vs $/1k tokens with smooth iso-cost contours; 2) small stacked waterfall showing unit-cost drop from batching, cache, quant. will mock.

sam: dataset note  we've got 6 workloads: chat, qna, code, summary, search, rerank. will export median+95th and cost calc per 1k tokens. CSV by 4pm.

lina: webinar plan: 25m talk + 15m live Q&A. Sections: market pain, demo: same prompt through three routing policies, chart walkthrough, customer use-case, CTA.

maya: inbound: two CTAs on landing: "Try hosted" and "Book dedicated consult". Tag leads with est token usage. >50k => AE alert. >500k => SE alert.

jon: microcopy candidates: "Speed you can predict. Costs you can control." or "Predictable inference. Predictable economics." Preferences?

priya: vote for the first one (predict/control) 1 chars punchier.

sam: chart specs for eng reproducibility:
```
chartA: scatter(x=median_latency_ms, y=cost_per_1k)
  color=model_variant
  iso_contours(cost_levels=[0.01,0.03,0.06])
  annotate(seq_length=64)

chartB: waterfall unit_cost
  steps=[no_batch, batching(8), kv_cache(prefix_common), quantize(4bit)]
  y_axis=$/1k
```

priya: nice. will keep palette brand + colorblind-safe. will produce two visual variants: conservative and dramatized for A/B.

lina: landing needs 3 lead magnets: benchmark PDF (email gated), 5m demo video (open), ROI calculator (interactive).

maya: routing flow: signup -> drip (3 emails). If lead_size>50k then AE gets ping and calendar invite. If >500k also page solutions-eng and sales-sdr.

jon: quick note on claims: avoid absolute numbers like "X% cheaper" unless we qualify with workload and seq length. Use ranges or "up to" with footnote.

priya: agreed. i'll annotate charts with callouts: typical chat (64 tokens), long context (512 tokens) behavior.

sam: pushing CSV and scripts to /shared/bench/launch/ by 15:45 UTC. includes measurement script, cost calc notebook.

maya: good. timeline check: visuals mock by today 6pm PST, landing copy + CTAs by tomorrow morning, QA deploy Wed.

lina: can we lock an internal preview Thurs 9am? marketing+eng+product to review.

jon: scheduled tentatively. i'll send invite.

priya: hero options for social (short form):
- "Make inference predictable."
- "Latency you can plan for. Costs you can budget."
- "Know your latency. Know your spend."
Which works for twitter?

lina: 2 is best for clarity. 3 is nice short too.

maya: social hooks: 1-line summary + link to PDF. keep one stat highlight (careful w/ absolutes).

sam: deploy-bot: Reminder: staging landing mock deploy scheduled 2026-03-27T02:00:00Z.

maya: action items recap:
- hero copy: "Speed you can predict. Costs you can control." (final)
- visuals: scatter + waterfall (priors from sam)
- assets: PDF, demo vid, ROI calc
- inbound routing: lead_size buckets (<50k, 50k-500k, >500k) with AE/SE alerts
- webinar: 25m + 15m Q&A, demo of routing policies

priya: will upload mocks to the doc thread when done.

jon: i'll draft the landing bullets + gated PDF outline.

lina: i'll write promo emails for the drip.

maya: thanks all. please add any unresolved items here. :thumbsup:

jon: :rocket:

priya: :art:

lina: :calendar:
